description: One page of profile posts through the app's PolarisProfilePostsQuery. The document id and variables are observed from browser traffic and reused; a changed response shape fails the run.
observation_recipe: open a profile page and record the PolarisProfilePostsQuery POST body
page a second time and record the after cursor
re-observe after the query is rejected
verification_cases: identity: post shortcodes come from edges
pagination: the next page uses end_cursor
shape drift: an unrecognized edge fails the page
auth: a login redirect parks the job
